research.title: Claude Security: A Multi-Agent Vulnerability Scanner That Lives in Your Terminal
research.whyTrending: Anthropic's Claude Security plugin came out of closed preview into open beta for all Claude Code users. It runs a coordinated agent set that maps the codebase, reasons about threats, correlates issues across files and business logic, independently double-checks findings, then emits patch files you review and apply. Scans recent changes or a whole repo using inference you're already paying for. Nobody has written the honest 'what it actually catches vs what it misses vs Semgrep/CodeQL' piece, and it's the natural sequel to the keyv hardening post.
